# OpenAI Python SDK Releases — captured 2026-08-07
Source: https://github.com/openai/openai-python/releases
Prior cache: v2.44.0 (2026-07-08). Now: v2.53.0.

- v2.53.0 (Aug 3, 2026) — GPT-5.5 model support; tool response types gain name/namespace attributes.
- v2.52.1 (Jul 31, 2026) — CI pin maintenance.
- v2.52.0 (Jul 31, 2026) — **content provenance checks API**; client honors retry-after up to 2 min;
  mTLS HTTP client docs. [REPORTED]
- v2.51.0 (Jul 30, 2026) — **fast tier** service tier; helper methods updated.
- v2.50.0 (Jul 28, 2026) — transcription model updates.
- v2.49.0 (Jul 27, 2026) — min Python 3.10.
- Earlier in window — **admin spend-limit APIs**, configurable safety parameters, and
  **organizational service-account key management endpoints**. [REPORTED]

Updated: 2026-08-07 — 9 releases since the prior cache. Reportable: content provenance checks API;
org service-account key management + admin spend-limit APIs. GPT-5.6 family (sol/terra/luna) is
confirmed on official OpenAI surfaces (openai.com/index/gpt-5-6/, Codex changelog, Models docs) even
though these SDK notes label the Aug 3 entry "GPT-5.5".
